第16章 看谁的摊子先被端-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

第二天，刘老四来得更早，桌子又往前挪了半米。

他的烧饼比昨天多了一倍，显然是想用数量压人。

林国强的生意又差了两成。

第三天，刘老四的摊子旁边多了一个人。

一个剃着光头的年轻人，二十出头，膀大腰圆。

穿着一件脏兮兮的皮夹克，蹲在路边抽烟，时不时往林国强的方向瞟一眼。

那眼神不善。

胖嫂趁着没人的时候，偷偷跟林国强说：“大兄弟，你小心点。

刘老四这人不好惹，他在镇上有关系，之前摆摊的几个人都是被他挤走的。

那个光头是他外甥，叫二彪，是个混不吝的，去年把人肋骨打断了两根，赔了人家好几百块才了事。”

林国强点了点头：“谢谢胖嫂，我心里有数。”

“你可别硬来啊，”胖嫂压低了声音，“实在不行换个地方，农机厂门口又不是只有这一个地儿……”

“不换。”林国强笑了笑，带着不容置疑，“这是我先来的，凭什么我换？”

胖嫂张了张嘴，想说什么，又咽了回去，叹了口气走了。

那天收摊回家，赵素梅发现林国强脸色不对。

“咋了？生意不好？”

“还行，就是有人抢地盘。”

赵素梅的脸一下子白了：“谁？”

“刘老四，隔壁村的。”

“刘老四？”赵素梅的声音都变了，“我听说过这个人，他不是好东西。

国强，要不咱们换个地方吧，犯不着跟他斗……”

“不换。”林国强把箱子放下，语气平静但坚定，“素梅，你听我说，这种人，你退一步，他就进两步。

你今天换了地方，他明天照样跟过来，退让解决不了问题。”

“那你想咋办？”

林国强没有回答，但从那天起，他开始做一件事。

每天收摊之后，他不急着回家，而是在镇上多待一个小时，到处转悠。

他去农机厂后面的家属区转，去镇上的菜市场转，去供销社门口转。

甚至去镇政府门口转了一圈。

他在观察，也在打听。

刘老四是什么来头？

他在镇上的“关系”到底是谁？

他之前是怎么挤走别人的？

他有什么软肋？

三天下来，林国强把情况摸得差不多了。

The next day, Liu Laosi came earlier and moved the table half a meter forward.

He had twice as many sesame seed cakes as yesterday, obviously trying to overwhelm others with quantity.

Lin Guoqiang's business dropped by another 20%.

On the third day, there was an extra person next to Liu Laosi’s stall.

A young man with a shaved head, in his early twenties, with a big body and a round waist.

Wearing a dirty leather jacket, he squatted on the roadside smoking, glancing in Lin Guoqiang's direction from time to time.

That look was not kind.

The fat sister-in-law secretly said to Lin Guoqiang when no one was around: "Brother, be careful.

Liu Laosi is not a person to be trifled with. He has connections in the town, and he has squeezed out the few people who set up stalls before.

The bald man is his nephew, named Er Biao, who is a generous man. Last year, he broke two of a man's ribs and had to pay him several hundred yuan before settling the matter."

Lin Guoqiang nodded: "Thank you, Fatty Sister-in-law, I know it well."

"Don't force yourself," the fat lady lowered her voice, "It's really hard to find another place. This is not the only place in front of the agricultural machinery factory..."

"I won't change." Lin Guoqiang smiled, with no doubt, "I came here first, why should I change?"

The fat lady opened her mouth, wanted to say something, swallowed it back, sighed and left.

When Zhao Sumei closed the stall and went home that day, she noticed that Lin Guoqiang looked wrong.

"What's wrong? Business is not good?"

"It's okay, but there are people grabbing the territory."

Zhao Sumei's face suddenly turned pale: "Who?"

"Liu Laosi, from the next village."

"Liu Laosi?" Zhao Sumei's voice changed, "I have heard of this person, he is not a good person.

Guoqiang, why don’t we change places so we don’t have to fight with him..."

"No change." Lin Guoqiang put the box down and said in a calm but firm tone, "Su Mei, listen to me, for this kind of person, if you take one step back, he will take two steps forward.

If you change places today, he will still follow you tomorrow. Giving in will not solve the problem."

"Then what do you want to do?"

Lin Guoqiang did not answer, but from that day on, he started to do something.

After closing his stall every day, he was not in a hurry to go home. Instead, he stayed in the town for an extra hour and wandered around.

He went to the family area behind the agricultural machinery factory, to the vegetable market in the town, and to the entrance of the supply and marketing cooperative.

I even went to the town government gate for a walk.

He was observing and inquiring.

What is Liu Laosi's background?

Who are his "connections" in town?

How did he crowd out others before?

What's his weakness?

After three days, Lin Guoqiang had almost figured out the situation.
